title: HuntLoop Resume Deep-Dive
description: Resume Deep-Dive activity and Modal budget use. Unlike this project's other dashboards, every panel here reads POSTGRES directly (datasource uid huntloop-postgres) rather than Prometheus: Deep-Dive state lives in the resume_deep_dives table and the budget in the modal_usage ledger, and 'how many runs are in each status right now' is a row count, not a pushed counter. Every query is a read-only SELECT. Prometheus-side Modal counters (including function=deep_dive_remote) are on the 'HuntLoop Modal Resume Processing' dashboard instead.

panels.title: Modal budget used vs cap, this month
panels.description: From the modal_usage ledger (huntloop.modal_resume_processing._reserve_invocation_slot) for the CURRENT calendar month. Counts weighted invocations, not calls: a resume parse/embed reserves 1, a Deep-Dive reserves MODAL_DEEP_DIVE_WEIGHT (default 5). The cap itself lives in MODAL_MONTHLY_INVOCATION_BUDGET, which the database does not know, so the threshold here is the default 500 - adjust it if that env var is changed. Budget-threshold alert emails fire at 80% and 95% (huntloop.budget_alerts).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(invocations_used), 0) AS "Invocations used" FROM modal_usage WHERE month = to_char(now(), 'YYYY-MM');

panels.title: Deep-Dives by status
panels.description: Current row counts in resume_deep_dives, grouped by status (pending / running / done / failed - huntloop.db_models.DeepDiveStatus). A persistent `running` count that never drains is the signal for runs whose Modal call never resolved; those become re-dispatchable after DEEP_DIVE_STALE_MINUTES.

targets.rawSql: SELECT status::text AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM resume_deep_dives GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;

panels.title: Average completion time of finished runs
panels.description: AVG(updated_at - dispatched_at) over `done` rows only, in seconds. updated_at is set when a poll reconciles the run to done, so this measures dispatch-to-observed-completion - it includes the gap until the frontend's next poll noticed, not purely Modal execution time. Rows with no dispatched_at (never dispatched) are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - dispatched_at))) AS "Avg completion (s)", COUNT(*) AS "Finished runs" FROM resume_deep_dives WHERE status = 'done' AND dispatched_at IS NOT NULL;

panels.title: Deep-Dive failures over time
panels.description: Failed runs bucketed by day, from resume_deep_dives.updated_at (when the run was recorded as failed). Includes every failure cause: a refused dispatch (Modal unavailable or the budget cap), an expired Modal output, the remote function raising, and a result that failed shape validation. The sanitized `error` text on each row says which; this panel is the volume signal.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', updated_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "failures" FROM resume_deep_dives WHERE status = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(updated_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Deep-Dive runs started over time
panels.description: Runs bucketed by day from resume_deep_dives.dispatched_at - i.e. when Modal budget was actually spent, not when the row was created. Read alongside the budget gauge above: each bar costs MODAL_DEEP_DIVE_WEIGHT (default 5) ledger slots.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', dispatched_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "runs started" FROM resume_deep_dives WHERE dispatched_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(dispatched_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
